value.rationale: Unrestricted arbitrary-topology probability recovery is a natural stronger observational task than identifying a single phylogeny. The precise minimal moment degree, complete 74-dimensional first-order blind space and explicit trade are usable self-contained finite classification results without requiring an n-general theorem.

final_claim: For 105 fully binary labelled unrooted six-taxon trees and 45 yes/no resolved quartet tests, spans of monomials of degrees 0,1,2 have dimensions 1,31,105; a four-tree trade has equal singleton probabilities but different joint pair event.
limitations: No claim about >=7 leaves, noise stability, or independently sampled gene trees.
